pattern: \[Win32App\]\[ReportingManager\] Execution state for app with id: {GUID} has been updated\. Report delta: \{"{1,2}EnforcementState"{1,2}:\{"{1,2}OldValue"{1,2}:(?:"{1,2}\w+"{1,2}|null),"{1,2}NewValue"{1,2}:"{1,2}Success"{1,2}
description: Detects when an app's enforcement state transitions to Success in an Execution state report delta. OldValue is deliberately unpinned: besides InProgressDownloadCompleted it can be Error (retry succeeding in a later check-in), InProgressPendingReboot (post-reboot completion) or null (first write) — the previously pinned InProgressDownloadCompleted missed those legitimate success paths (IME 1.97 audit 2026-08-17). Quote-flexible since 2026-08-17: IME 1.104 serializes the report-delta JSON with single quotes ({"Key":...) where older versions logged doubled quotes ({""Key"":...) - every literal quote in the delta is matched as "{1,2} to cover both.
